```{r try1, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
n <- 30
lambda <- 0.15  
t_event <- rexp(n, rate = lambda)  
t_cens  <- runif(n, min = 1, max = 10) 

time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)  
status <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens) 
group <- 30 

dat <- data.frame(id = 1:n, t_event, t_cens, time, status)

dat <- dat |>
  mutate(type = ifelse(status == 1, "event", "censored")) |>
  arrange(time) |>
  mutate(order = row_number()) |>
  select(-t_event, -t_cens) |>
  relocate(order) 

fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = dat)

sf <- summary(fit)
km_df <- data.frame(time = sf$time, surv = sf$surv, n.censor = sf$n.censor)
km_df <- rbind(data.frame(time = 0, surv = 1, n.censor = 0), km_df) 

ggplot(km_df, aes(time, surv)) +
  geom_step(size = 1.1) +                                 
  geom_point(data = subset(km_df, n.censor > 0),            
             shape = 3, size = 2, stroke = 0.9) +              
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .02))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max(km_df$time)), by = 2)) +
  labs(title = "Kaplan–Meier Curve", x = "Time", y = "Survival Probability") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```


```{r}
set.seed(2025)

# ---- 可调参数 ----
n_total <- 200            # 总样本量
p_group1 <- 0.5           # 组1比例（其余为组0）
HR       <- 1.5           # 组1 vs 组0 的风险比
lambda   <- 0.12          # Weibull 尺度（越大事件越快）
gamma    <- 1.3           # Weibull 形状(>1 风险随时升；=1 指数；<1 降)

# 行政删失（调节删失强度）
cens_min <- 2
cens_max <- 8

# ---- 分组变量 ----
group <- rbinom(n_total, 1, p_group1)       # 0/1 组
beta  <- log(HR)

# ---- 事件时间（Weibull + PH）----
# 组别影响通过 rate = lambda * exp(beta*group)，对应 rweibull 的 scale 需要转换
scale_i <- (1 / (lambda * exp(beta * group)))^(1/gamma)
t_event <- stats::rweibull(n_total, shape = gamma, scale = scale_i)

# ---- 删失时间（行政性）----
t_cens  <- runif(n_total, cens_min, cens_max)

# ---- 观测量 ----
time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)
status <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens)     # 1=事件, 0=删失

dat <- data.frame(
  id = seq_len(n_total),
  group = factor(group, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("G0","G1")),
  time = time,
  status = status
)

# 简要查看删失比例
prop.table(table(dat$status))
# 分组计数
table(dat$group, dat$status)


lr <- survdiff(Surv(time, status) ~ group, data = dat)
lr
# 卡方统计量：
lr$chisq
# p 值（自由度 = 组数 - 1）
pval <- pchisq(lr$chisq, df = length(levels(dat$group)) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
pval
```


```{r}
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ group, data = dat)

# 用 summary 抽“整洁”的分层数据（含 n.censor）
sf <- summary(fit)
km_df <- data.frame(
  time     = sf$time,
  surv     = sf$surv,
  strata   = sf$strata,       # "group=G0"/"group=G1"
  n.risk   = sf$n.risk,
  n.event  = sf$n.event,
  n.censor = sf$n.censor
)

# 每层补 t=0, S=1，保证阶梯从 1 开始
t0 <- km_df %>% distinct(strata) %>%
  mutate(time = 0, surv = 1, n.risk = NA, n.event = 0, n.censor = 0)
km_df <- bind_rows(t0, km_df) %>% arrange(strata, time)

# 绘图
ggplot(km_df, aes(time, surv, colour = strata, group = strata)) +
  geom_step(size = 1.1) +
  geom_point(data = subset(km_df, n.censor > 0),
             shape = 3, size = 2, stroke = 0.9) +   # “+” 号=删失
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0,.02))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("group=G0" = "steelblue", "group=G1" = "firebrick"),
                     labels = c("G0","G1"), name = "Group") +
  labs(title = "Kaplan–Meier Curves by Group",
       x = "Time", y = "Survival Probability") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

```


```{r}
set.seed(2025)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

## ---- 1) 设定多臂参数 ----
arms   <- c("Control","TxA","TxB")        # 三个治疗臂
n_arm  <- c(120, 120, 120)                # 各臂样本量
HR_arm <- c(1.00, 0.80, 0.60)             # 相对对照臂的真实HR（PH假设）

# Weibull 基线（率-形状参数化）
lambda <- 0.12                             # 基线率
gamma  <- 1.30                             # 形状 (>1 风险随时升; =1 指数; <1 下降)

# 行政性删失范围
cens_min <- 2
cens_max <- 8

## ---- 2) 生成分组与个体层参数 ----
dat <- data.frame(
  arm = factor(rep(arms, times = n_arm), levels = arms)
)

beta  <- log(HR_arm)                       # β=log(HR)
b_map <- setNames(beta, arms)              # 映射到具体臂
eta   <- (1 / (lambda * exp(b_map[dat$arm])))^(1/gamma)  # 每人的尺度参数 η_i

## ---- 3) 生成事件时间 + 删失时间 ----
t_event <- rweibull(nrow(dat), shape = gamma, scale = eta)
t_cens  <- runif(nrow(dat), cens_min, cens_max)

dat$time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)
dat$status <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens)     # 1=事件, 0=删失

## ---- 4) 拟合并整理 KM 数据 ----
fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ arm, data = dat)

sf <- summary(fit)
km_df <- data.frame(
  time     = sf$time,
  surv     = sf$surv,
  strata   = sf$strata,     # 形如 "arm=Control"
  n.risk   = sf$n.risk,
  n.event  = sf$n.event,
  n.censor = sf$n.censor
)

# 给每条曲线补 t=0, S=1 起点
t0 <- km_df %>% distinct(strata) %>%
  mutate(time = 0, surv = 1, n.risk = NA, n.event = 0, n.censor = 0)
km_df <- bind_rows(t0, km_df) %>% arrange(strata, time)

## ---- 5) 画多臂 KM（带删失“+”）----
ggplot(km_df, aes(time, surv, colour = strata, group = strata)) +
  geom_step(size = 1.1) +
  geom_point(data = subset(km_df, n.censor > 0),
             shape = 3, size = 2, stroke = 0.9) +  # “+”表示删失
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0,.02))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("arm=Control"="grey30",
                                "arm=TxA"    ="steelblue",
                                "arm=TxB"    ="firebrick"),
                     labels = arms, name = "Arm") +
  labs(title = "Multi-arm Kaplan–Meier Curves",
       x = "Time", y = "Survival Probability") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

```
